description: This file contains logging functions for the TestLink project, including functions for audit events, warning events, localization logs, general event logging, and timing utilities for performance measurement.

methods.name: logAuditEvent
methods.description: Fires an audit event log with specified message, event code, object ID, object type, and source.

methods.name: logWarningEvent
methods.description: Logs a warning event with specified message, activity code, object ID, and object type.

methods.name: logL18NWarningEvent
methods.description: Logs a localization (L18N) warning event with specified message, activity code, object ID, and object type.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs a general event based on an event object containing message, log level, source, object ID, object type, and code.

methods.name: tLog
methods.description: Core logging function that records messages with specified level, source, object info, and activity code, utilizing a global logger object.

methods.name: tlTimingStart
methods.description: Starts a timing measurement with a given name.

methods.name: tlTimingStop
methods.description: Stops a timing measurement with a given name.

methods.name: tlTimingCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current elapsed time for a named timer.
